note: All beds are conformed to exactly 120 BPM (Motion.md grid, 1 beat = 15 frames at 30 fps) with rubberband, resampled to 48 kHz stereo, extended to 64 s by repeating loop_start..loop_end (raised-cosine 40 ms crossfades, sample-aligned), normalized to -16 LUFS. To go longer, repeat the same region; mix.py does this automatically. beat_phase_s is the time of the first beat modulo 0.5 s; mix.py shifts the bed so beats land on 15-frame multiples.
